source: AI-assisted recolor of the existing FixxFlow ribbon F and wrench, authorized by the product owner in October 2026
method: Built-in imagegen background extraction, with final alpha matting against the clean inverse master and existing transparent master silhouette to preserve crisp lettering and navy folds. Sharp performs alpha validation, crop and resize.

prompts.primary: Edit this exact FixxFlow logo, only recolor. Preserve the ribbon F with circular wrench, precise silhouette, wordmark spelling FixxFlow and tagline IT SUPPORT IN MOTION, layout and proportions. Replace all blue/cyan ribbon and Flow text with gold #FCA311 highlights and amber-gold shading; deepest ribbon folds navy #14213D. Fixx text navy, tagline dark neutral gray. Wrench white. Transparent background.
prompts.dark: Use case: background-extraction. Edit target: the attached FixxFlow logo. Remove ONLY the navy rectangular background and replace it with real alpha transparency everywhere outside the logo, including the gaps and holes between letters. Preserve the gold ribbon F, its internal navy folds, white wrench, gold Flow letters, white Fixx letters, and the exact tagline IT SUPPORT IN MOTION. Keep all typography, shapes, layout, colors and spacing unchanged. Crisp smooth edges and intact solid letter interiors; no rough edges, speckles, paint splashes, extra outlines, glow, checkerboard, matte or background color. Final deliverable is a transparent PNG logo, not a logo on a navy panel.

derivatives: Navigation mark, horizontal lockups, source masters, app icons, Apple/Android icons and ICO all derive from the same gold logo.
darkArtwork: All full inverse and reversed logo assets have genuine alpha transparency. The app uses the dark-mode-transparent filename to bypass previous opaque image caches. Navy remains only inside the ribbon folds.
